approaches.title: Index-based doubly linked list with hash map
approaches.summary: Uses a hash map from keys to entries stored in a vector, with indexed previous/next links to track least- and most-recently-used items. Both revisions are marked wrong because the implementation still has correctness issues.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Introduces the hash-map and indexed doubly linked-list design for LRU lookup, recency updates, insertion, and eviction. The revision is marked wrong.
